# Tom Sesler — Product Designer

> Product designer building digital experiences — interface design, design systems, and live, shipped products.

## About

Tom Sesler is a product designer. He designs products end-to-end — from interactive prototypes in Figma to deployed, maintained production sites, using an AI-assisted build workflow (Claude, Cursor) rather than hand-writing code. His portfolio at straydesign.co showcases case studies, shipped products, and design-process work. Based in Erie, PA and relocating to the New Hampshire seacoast; open to full-time and remote roles.

## Skills & Expertise

- Product Design (end-to-end, Figma)
- Interface Design & Design Systems (components, prototyping, responsive, mobile-first)
- Heuristic Evaluation
- Brand & Visual Identity (typography, color, photography he shoots and edits himself)
- AI-assisted build & deployment (Claude, Cursor, Git, Vercel) — design to live production

## Key Projects

### MIDDLEMAN — Merchandising System
Bloomberg Terminal-inspired mobile app concept for beer merchandisers. Real-time POS data, auto-orders, shrinkage detection. Live prototype with a custom design system.

### FirstDay.Life
AI-powered goal tracker with iterative weekly sprints. Designed, built (AI-assisted), and shipped as a live product.

### DoorDash Dasher App UX Critique
A heuristic evaluation (Nielsen's 10 heuristics) of the driver app, informed firsthand by 1,000+ deliveries driven on the platform, with five redesign proposals.

## Education

University of New Hampshire — B.S. Marketing

## What Tom Does

- Product Design — end-to-end product design from concept through shipped interfaces
- UX & Interface Design — interface design, prototyping, and design systems
- Build & Deployment — sites taken from design to live production via an AI-assisted build workflow (Claude, Cursor), including custom CMS back ends so non-technical owners can edit their own content
